A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same WikiCLIP work. All 16 pages of each version, including appendix text, equations, tables, and figures, are available and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original recognition experiments on OVEN, INFOSEEK, and E-VQA, together with ablations, efficiency measurements, retrieval results, and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds joint scaling, stronger-baseline, and VGKA architecture experiments in Appendix A.1.

M1.justification: The VGKA architecture, hard-negative synthesis procedure, contrastive objective, and retrieval inference remain unchanged. The newly evaluated architecture variants are ablations, not revisions to the proposed default method.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation retain OVEN, INFOSEEK, E-VQA, and their Wikipedia knowledge bases. The added experiments vary model configurations within existing recognition tasks, without introducing new datasets, domains, or test scenarios.

E2.justification: New Table 7 adds an EVA-CLIP-8B implementation of CLIP2CLIP as a stronger OVEN comparator against WikiCLIP-S. Existing comparison tables retain their baseline membership. The newly cited KnowCoL is not evaluated.

E3.justification: The new experiments jointly cross 1B/3B/8B LLM sizes with 128/256/512-token inputs, evaluate CLIP2CLIP with EVA-CLIP-8B, and test VGKA layer/head combinations of 2/16, 8/16, and 16/32. Existing splits, metrics, training settings, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix A.1 extends the existing sensitivity analyses with joint LLM-size/text-length testing, a control for visual-encoder scaling, and adapter architecture ablations. These bounded additions strengthen design checks; existing component ablations, error analyses, and visualizations are retained.

E5.justification: Figure 10(b) retains identical mean silhouette scores and standard-deviation bars. The added tables report point estimates without introducing seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 6–8 add configuration-specific results, including 12.6 OVEN HM for scaled CLIP2CLIP and INFOSEEK overall accuracies of 61.2, 60.6, and 59.1 for the three VGKA configurations. Existing benchmark scores, retrieval results, and plotted data are retained; these additions are not same-setting performance improvements.

T1.justification: The task formulation, attention and pooling equations, negative-replacement rule, inference score, and Appendix A.2 InfoNCE objective are unchanged. No new formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and headline claims: knowledge-guided contrastive recognition, hard-negative synthesis, strong unseen-entity generalization, and low inference latency. The additional experiments support these existing claims.

C2.justification: Appendix A.1 newly interprets the stronger-baseline comparison as evidence of benefits beyond encoder scaling and the architecture ablation as evidence of VGKA robustness. The joint-scaling discussion reinforces existing saturation arguments. The original limitations are retained after relocation.

D1.justification: Table 8 newly documents attention-head counts, including 16 heads for the retained two-layer VGKA and counts for deeper variants. Existing implementation and hardware details remain unchanged. The project-link label changes, but its embedded destination is identical.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds KnowCoL and positions its knowledge-graph approach as concurrent and orthogonal. SPHINX and AutoVER bibliography updates concern already cited works, rather than additional research.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized wording and grammatical edits, explicitly identifies Figure 6 as supplementary, and moves the limitations section into a paragraph following the conclusion. Appendix A.1 gains three analysis paragraphs; the broader narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds three appendix tables, rearranges existing displays, swaps Figure 3/4 numbering, and renumbers v1 Tables 5/6 as v3 Tables 9/5. Figure 1 removes the '+18.0% Accuracy' callout while retaining its plotted data. Other figure contents are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The stronger-backbone comparison in Table 7 addresses a control missing from v1, while the joint-scaling and architecture ablations strengthen support for design choices. These are useful but bounded gains. The new results lack uncertainty estimates, and Table 6 introduces an 8B-model labeling inconsistency: LLaMA3.2 there versus LLaMA3.1 in Section 4.6 and Figure 6.
